content:
The valid products of factors \(e_i+1\) are:
\[
70,\quad 2\cdot 35,\quad 5\cdot 14,\quad 7\cdot 10,\quad 2\cdot 5\cdot 7.
\]
Corresponding candidates with exponents assigned to smallest primes:
\[
2^{69},\quad 2^{34}\cdot 3,\quad 2^{13}\cdot 3^4,\quad 2^9\cdot 3^6,\quad 2^6\cdot 3^4\cdot 5.
\]
The smallest is
\[
2^6\cdot 3^4\cdot 5 = 64\cdot 81\cdot 5 = 25920.
\]
\[
\boxed{25920}
\]
